hero.split-panel: Large editorial headline with right-side service summary panel.
hero.urgent-conversion: Phone-first emergency layout with high-contrast CTA and fast proof strip.
hero.calm-authority: Reassuring service layout with softer proof and appointment-oriented CTA.
hero.authority-editorial: Professional, text-led authority layout with decision criteria.
hero.gallery-bento: Boutique layout with large hero card and bento-style highlights.
hero.saas-bento: Modern product-style hero with bento proof and compact feature cards.

proof.trust-strip: Short proof points across a horizontal strip.
proof.bento-proof: Proof points arranged in asymmetrical bento cards.
proof.phone-proof: Emergency proof row emphasizing availability path and contact speed without inventing guarantees.

services.cards: Four to six cards with short descriptions.
services.clustered: Grouped service clusters for businesses with many services.
services.checklist: Dense checklist for urgent or utility services.

process.rapid-response: Call, diagnose, dispatch/next step. Only use if emergency intent is known.

proofOrExpectation.expectations: Use process expectations when reviews are missing.
